tools.name: lookup_player
tools.description: Look up a player's Mizan record: their bans across every list Mizan reads, whether any list banned them for cheating, and Steam's own VAC and game bans for a Steam account. Pass a SteamID in any form, a Steam profile link, a Discord id or a Minecraft name.

tools.name: check_players
tools.description: Check up to 100 Steam accounts in one call, such as everyone on a game server: each account's bans across every list Mizan reads, whether a list banned it for cheating, and Steam's own VAC and game bans. Pass SteamIDs in any form or steamcommunity.com profile links; lines of a server's `status` outp

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the ban lists Mizan reads, largest first: each list's name, who issues its bans, the games it covers, its bans and how many are in force, and whether Mizan is still reading it. Filter by game key or by part of the name.

tools.name: registry_stats
tools.description: The size of Mizan's registry: how many ban lists it reads, the bans on them, how many are in force, and the same counts for each game.

tools.name: list_my_communities
tools.description: List the communities you belong to on Mizan, your role in each, their registry status and their game servers. Needs you to sign in to Mizan.
